_about: Settings that cannot change a result (requirement W2): parallelism, memory, time caps, timeouts, and retries, grouped by stage. Read through heidelberg/config.py as C.section.key.

connect_timeout_s.reason: a request that cannot connect within this fails and is retried or replaced by its fallback (R8)

read_timeout_s.reason: a request that does not answer within this fails

tap_tries.reason: attempts of a synchronous TAP query

tap_backoff_s.reason: wait between attempts, times the attempt's number

tap_maxrec.reason: the row cap of an upload join (far above any answer)

gavo_tries.reason: attempts at GAVO before IRSA is asked for Gaia

async_tries.reason: attempts of an async Gaia job at one service before the next is asked

async_wait_s.reason: the longest wait for an async job

async_maxrec.reason: the row cap of an async Gaia job (far above any tile's rows)

http_timeout_s.reason: an HTTP request's timeout (MAST's API, GAVO's cut-outs)

http_backoff_s.reason: wait between attempts, times the attempt's number

soda_backoff_s.reason: wait between attempts, times the attempt's number

vsx_tries.reason: attempts of a VSX cone before it is split (HD_VSX_TRIES overrides for split cones)

vsx_depth.reason: the most times a VSX cone is split before a last try (HD_VSX_DEPTH overrides)

vsx_backoff_s.reason: wait between VSX attempts, times the attempt's number

vsx_pause_s.reason: a pause before the last try of a cone that fails even split

vsx_courtesy_s.reason: a pause after each VSX answer (courtesy to AAVSO's server)

snapshot_maxrec.reason: the row cap of a snapshot's TAP query (far above the 131,000 rows of the largest)

gaia_tile_deg.reason: a Gaia query is split into tiles of about this side (bounded without overlap, so the stars are the same)

allsky_maxrec.reason: the row cap of the all-sky G < 11 query (1.25 million rows)

measure_passes.reason: measuring repeats the pairs not yet measured in up to this many passes

measure_max_removed.reason: after the passes, a pair still not measured is removed and reported; more than this share of the list missing stops the job (an outage, not a few unreadable scans)

tle_tries.reason: attempts to open the locked workspace once its round is due (drand answering)

ps1_workers.reason: concurrent reads of the Pan-STARRS copy's tiles

shadow_jobs.reason: processes fitting the shadow stage's toys (HD_JOBS overrides)

toy_chunk.reason: toys per task sent to a process

measure_par.reason: pairs measured at once on an r7i.4xlarge (the budget's assumption; the job sizes it from the machine's memory, K2)

ps1_random_workers.reason: concurrent reads of the Pan-STARRS copy for the random positions

gb_pair.reason: memory budgeted per pair measured at once: a third above the dry runs' peak (K2); five pairs on an r7i.4xlarge

select_jobs.reason: processes of the record job's selection

record_shadow_jobs.reason: processes of the record job's shadow stage

record_rec_workers.reason: processes of the record job's recurrence check

clock_parts.reason: the asteroid clock's plates are split into this many parts, run at once

ephem_workers.reason: processes integrating the orbits, one batch each

ephem_batch.reason: orbits per batch (each batch steps through every plate time once)

shadow_chunk.reason: lines of sight through the shadow model at once (memory only)

sun_cache.reason: times whose site and Sun positions are kept (speed only)
